description: This PHP file is part of a SuiteCRM module, specifically handling the display of 'My Tasks' for a user. It initializes a ListView, constructs a database query to fetch pending tasks assigned to the current user, and renders a list view with potential layout editing capabilities for admin users.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: A class responsible for managing list views and rendering data lists for the UI.

classes.name: BeanFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating new bean instances, such as tasks.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Loads language strings for a specific module based on the current language.

methods.name: $timedate->getNow()->get("+1 day")->asDb()
methods.description: Gets current date/time, adds one day, and formats it for database querying.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the template engine for rendering the list view.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Defines the SQL WHERE clause and ordering of the data to be fetched.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes the list view and outputs the HTML.
